approved_scope.title: Never write a project file through a symbolic link
approved_scope.description: Never write a project file through a symbolic link
acceptance_criteria: For each of hooks install and uninstall, agents install and uninstall, mcp lock --write, the scaffold registry append, migrate, new, scaffold, add-spec, wizard and import: with the file it writes, or a directory on the way to it, a symbolic link that leaves the project, a dangling link, or a non-regular file, the command refuses with an error naming the path, the link's target is unchanged and nothing is created outside the project; with a link to a regular file inside the project (CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md) it writes through the link; the resolve --remote cache is never read or written through any link and says so once on stderr; each new test fails on 7b6e4779 and passes with the fix

answers.constraints: hooks.3md: installing is idempotent and appends, never overwrites; the pre-commit, .gitignore and .gitattributes writers already refuse a symbolic link, and this change gives the other writers one rule. hash_cache.3md lesson from GHSA-7q5v-8jcc-rx54: a path this tool creates is still a path the repository chose, and a check followed by a path write leaves the window the check was for, so every write goes through a directory handle on the project root.
